free_tier.stated: 2 GB Sta.sh storage free, up to 100 GB with Core

egress.terms: free direct CDN links on wixmp.com; no egress metering

tooling: DeviantArt published API (OAuth2, /api/v1/.. stash endpoints); mostly stale since the 2020 ownership change. Wrapper risk is high.
chaining: 2 GB x unlimited free accounts. 500 GB = 250 accounts. Repeatable but tedious; the 200 MB per-file cap is the more useful dimension for mixed data.
limits_note: 2 GB total free (hard cap, not per-file); non-image files 200 MB (1 GB Core); video submissions Core-only; Sta.sh items are private until published
reliability_note: 2 GB is a real, enforced bucket cap and the API is legacy; no bulk path worth building
